name: TariffRateComparer
tagline: Find every customer's cheapest tariff – and move them to it.
description: A complete utility customer-operations app for Power Apps and Power Pages: compares flat, tiered, time-of-use, EV, solar-export and demand tariffs side by side, simulates 12 monthly bills, runs what-if scenarios, protects priority-register customers and manages the recommendation, offer and switch pipeline.
features: Six tariff structures with configurable rates
12-month bill simulation with seasonal usage, solar yield and export credit
What-if: shift peak use, add EV, add solar
Eligibility, exit fee and minimum-saving rules
Status workflow with allowed transitions, confirmations and undo
Phone layout with bottom view bar
controlType: standard (2 controls: TariffRateComparer data-set + TariffRateComparerPortal field control)
